title: OneDrive and SharePoint: single hero link for file and folder sharing
summary: The briefing passes: the rollout, default audience, licensing context and administrative commands are supported. It correctly reports the conflicting documentation on OneDrive support and audience values. The legacy sharing-link path needs a small clarification about choosing the default after clearing the inheritance checkbox.

claims.quote: The default audience for main links used in sharing. Applies to all items at the root of the document library. Only audience scope is set by this parameter. The default effective value is `OnlyPeopleAdded`.

claims.fix: Keep the documented path and add to controls[3].note: 'Clear Same as organization-level setting, then choose the default sharing link setting for the site.' The cited page requires the choice after clearing inheritance: https://learn.microsoft.com/sharepoint/change-default-sharing-link.

claims.claim: Set-SPOSite -Identity <site URL> -DefaultSharingLinkType <value> sets the legacy default link type for a site.
claims.quote:
### -DefaultSharingLinkType
The default link type for the site collection. To be replaced by DefaultShareLinkScope.
PARAMVALUE: None | AnonymousAccess | Internal | Direct

claims.claim: Teams private or shared channel sites require Set-SPOSite rather than the admin-centre route to change the default link type.

claims.quote: Searched: 'SharePoint hero link DefaultMainLinkScope admin center UI tenant default Set-SPOTenant' and '"hero link" autonomous agent sharing admin controls'; read shareable-links, Set-SPOSite, Set-SPOTenant and MC1454378. Only the site audience default was documented.

claims.quote: The default audience for main links used in sharing. Applies to all items at the root of the document library.

- Anyone
